summary: Every session file write goes through cliutil.WithFileLock and a unique temp file; Shop records raw Set-Cookie headers in a RoundTripper so a renewed remember-me cookie keeps its new expiry; Persist merges this run's cookie updates into the file as it is on disk and never writes the market back; markets select uses UpdateMarket, which re-reads under the lock.
reason: cookiejar.Jar exposes cookie values but never expiry, and a load-modify-save without the lock lets two CLI runs (or an MCP host running commands in parallel) overwrite each other's rotated session cookies or a newer market selection, which logs the customer out or sends the next call to the wrong market.
validated_outcome: TestRenewedRememberCookieKeepsNewExpiry, TestUpdateMarketKeepsRotatedCookies, TestPersistKeepsMarketSelectedElsewhere and TestSaveMergedKeepsOtherRunsCookies pass.
